pattern: an attached checkout blocks authorized work
experience: An agent starts another conversation because its current checkout contains unrelated staged changes, leaving the user's conversation and context behind.

source.origin: Authored Acme reproduction of a same-thread checkout recovery failure reported on 2026-11-12. No user content.

setup.context: This conversation is attached to /home/user/acme/old on branch feature/old. It contains unrelated staged and untracked files. Preserve them. The project root /home/user/acme/app is a Git repository with origin/main available. A fresh managed worktree is authorized.

t3_worktree_handoff.note: The same conversation continues in the new checkout next turn.

prompt: Continue the authorized repair here. Get a fresh checkout from origin/main without changing the staged or untracked files. Keep this conversation and resume automatically in the new checkout.
notes: Measures same-thread tool selection, not real provider resume or checkout preservation. Service and lease tests own those contracts.

pattern: the required branch already has a checkout
experience: An agent cannot bind its conversation to a verified existing checkout and instead launches a replacement conversation.

source.origin: Authored Acme existing-checkout variant of the same-thread recovery failure.

setup.context: The current thread's saved checkout /home/user/acme/deleted is missing. /home/user/acme/repair is a verified existing Git worktree of this project, on feature/repair, with no T3 owner or foreign lease. Its local files must stay unchanged during attachment.

t3_worktree_handoff.note: The same conversation continues in the attached checkout next turn.

prompt: Attach this conversation to the inspected /home/user/acme/repair checkout on feature/repair, then resume the authorized repair automatically. Keep the full conversation here, leave checkout files untouched, and do not run setup.
notes: Requires attaching the requested checkout rather than creating a different branch or conversation.

pattern: inspection does not authorize a move
experience: A checkout inspection must leave the current binding and files alone.

source.origin: Authored Acme read-only control for checkout switching.

prompt: Which checkout is this conversation attached to? Just inspect the binding; don't change anything.
